summary:
Implemented the Tabs feature but did not run any tests, since the instructions ruled that out. Checked by reading only.

Changes:
- src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (new): Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs. Exports Tab and Tabs via __all__. Focusable, two-row default style, keyboard/digit/search/Escape handling, click actions via range_clicked, and a watcher on _active_tab_name that animates _bar_position.
- src/textual/renderables/underline_bar.py: returns one Text; clickable_ranges added before width; click spans appended last; early path has no click metadata.
- src/textual/renderables/opacity.py: merges blended color into existing style so meta is preserved.
- docs/reference/tabs.md (new), sandbox/tabs_demo.py (new, no stylesheet).
- tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py: four new tests appended, imports added at top, existing tests untouched.
- tests/widgets/__init__.py and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py (new).

Decisions: layout resolver already had min_size on its Edge protocol, so unchanged. Tabs sets can_focus=True. Zero-width label edges are kept out of layout_resolve (it treats size 0 as flexible) and placed at zero.

Open issues:
- With duplicate names before the active tab, the spec's find_tab_by_name index (full list) disagrees with the displayed index used for the highlight, so the underline can land on the wrong tab. I followed the spec literally; switching both to the displayed index is recommended but needs the user's decision.
- Tab names containing a single quote will break the range_clicked action parser; the spec mandates single quotes, so left as is.
